arStrings.szText: Your {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills gain the effect of every Upgrade. Damaging an enemy with a {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill causes them to take {c_random}[Affix_Value_1 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage from your other {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.
